Lymphatic Congestion

Ailment lymphedema lymphatic fluid-retention swelling

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Poor lymphatic drainage leading to swelling, particularly in extremities.

Symptoms

  • swelling in arms/legs
  • heaviness
  • tightness
  • recurring infections

Other Treatment Options

  • Edema, Fluid Retention
    Excess fluid accumulation in tissues causing swelling, typically in legs, ankles, or abdomen. Can be caused by heart conditions, kidney dysfunction, liver disease, or medication side effects.
  • Lymphedema
    Lymphatic system dysfunction causing chronic swelling, usually in arms or legs, when lymph fluid cannot drain adequately.
  • Diabetes
    Metabolic disorder characterized by high blood sugar levels due to insulin resistance or deficiency.
  • Chronic Kidney Disease
    Progressive kidney dysfunction that can lead to kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. Often causes severe edema and electrolyte imbalances.
  • Parasitic Infections
    Intestinal parasitic infections causing digestive distress and nutrient malabsorption.
  • Cleavers (Galium aparine)
    Traditional lymphatic tonic that supports lymphatic drainage and reduces fluid retention.
